purpose: ESO VLT/NACO (NAOS+CONICA) reduction from raw frames: darks, flats and the jitter recipe that combines a dithered imaging sequence, through esorex.
license: NACO pipeline GNU GPL-2.0 (naco-4.4.13/COPYING). The kit also carries erfa, fftw, cpl, cfitsio, wcslib, gsl and esorex under their own licences. Nothing is redistributed here; the kit is downloaded from ESO and verified against this pin.
note: The kit's install_pipeline builds cpl, esorex and the naco recipes into output/toolchains/naco/pipeline, and unpacks the static calibration into output/toolchains/naco/calib. The cksum value is ESO's own, published beside the kit at naco-kit-4.4.13-15.tar.gz.cksum, and is checked as well as the sha256 because it is the only digest ESO states.
